summary.goal: Implement version management and structural diff computation between plan versions
summary.context: Every meaningful change produces a new version. Diffs are structural (step added/removed/modified), not just text. Supports field-level change tracking and RFC 6902-style patches.

acceptance_criteria.description: New version can be created from existing version
Version numbers are monotonically increasing within a plan
Structural diff detects: steps added, removed, modified
Field-level changes tracked for modified steps
Dependency edge changes are tracked
Diff output is machine-readable (JSON patch format)

steps.title: Define VersionDiff interface
steps.description: Create src/domain/diff.ts with VersionDiff interface capturing structural changes between versions.

acceptance_criteria.description: VersionDiff has from_version: number, to_version: number
VersionDiff has steps_added: StepChange[]
VersionDiff has steps_removed: StepChange[]
VersionDiff has steps_modified: StepModification[]
VersionDiff has summary_changed: boolean

steps.title: Define StepChange and StepModification types
steps.description: Define types for step additions/removals and modifications with field-level changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: StepChange captures step_id and step snapshot
StepModification has step_id and field_changes array
FieldChange captures field name, old value, new value

steps.title: Implement createVersionFrom function
steps.description: Create function to create new version from existing version. Increments version number, sets status to draft.

acceptance_criteria.description: New version has incremented version number
New version status is 'draft'
New version copies steps from source version
New version has fresh timestamps

steps.title: Implement computeDiff function
steps.description: Create computeDiff(oldVersion, newVersion) that returns VersionDiff with all structural changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Detects steps added (new step_id not in old version)
Detects steps removed (old step_id not in new version)
Detects steps modified (same step_id, different content)
Tracks field-level changes for modified steps

steps.title: Implement dependency edge diff tracking
steps.description: Extend diff computation to track dependency changes separately for visibility.

acceptance_criteria.description: VersionDiff includes dependencies_added: EdgeChange[]
VersionDiff includes dependencies_removed: EdgeChange[]
EdgeChange captures from_step_id and to_step_id

steps.title: Implement toJsonPatch function
steps.description: Convert VersionDiff to RFC 6902 JSON Patch format for machine consumption.

acceptance_criteria.description: Output is valid JSON Patch array
Add operations for new steps
Remove operations for deleted steps
Replace operations for modified fields

steps.title: Add unit tests for versioning
steps.description: Write vitest tests for version creation and diff computation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests verify version increment is correct
Tests verify diff detects all change types
Tests verify JSON patch output is valid
Tests verify dependency edge tracking
All tests pass
